title: PageLedger Quality Line (JSONL)
description: One line of quality.jsonl — per-page diagnostic signals, not calibrated accuracy. Schema version 0.1.

confidence.description: Adapter-reported page confidence, 0–1. Evidence, not calibrated probability. Null when the engine reports none.

confidence_detail.description: Engine-native confidence evidence, adapter-defined shape. pdf_ocr reports Tesseract per-word statistics: scale, word_count, mean, min, below_60_count, below_60_ratio.

warnings.description: Quality warnings: empty_text, short_text, replacement_characters, control_characters, suspicious_symbol_density, fragmented_text, suspicious_embedded_text_delta, historical_orthography.

mean_token_length.description: Mean length of alphabetic tokens. Null when the page has none. Fragment noise collapses toward 1; tested prose sits above 4.

short_token_ratio.description: Share of alphabetic tokens with 1-2 characters. Null when the page has none.

prereform_letter_count.description: Occurrences of Cyrillic letters abolished by the 1918 Russian orthographic reform (ѣ, ѳ, ѵ). Modern Ukrainian/Belarusian і is deliberately not counted.

terminal_hard_sign_count.description: Word-final hard signs (ъ) — mandatory in pre-1918 Russian orthography, absent from modern text. Survives OCR even when abolished letters do not.

embedded_text_comparison.description: Comparison against the PDF's embedded text layer. Null when source is not a PDF or adapter already reports embedded_text capability.

grade.description: Deterministic evidence summary, not calibrated accuracy. Worst of the signal and schema axes. Only comparable within one adapter.

grade_basis.description: signals_only: graded on text signals alone (no alignment). schema_aware: schema column/check evidence contributed. A signals-only A is weaker evidence than a schema-aware A.

confidence_band.description: Null when the adapter reports no confidence — the signals grade then rests on warnings alone.
